name: écomiam S.A.
summary: Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Quimper, France, écomiam S.A. is a French food retailer. The company provides a wide array of provisions, encompassing appetizers, various meats and fish, seafood, fresh and processed vegetables, potato dishes, culinary essentials, baked goods, desserts, and organic products. These items are available for purchase both at its physical store locations and via its online platform.
